HDF5 1.14.4, Editor-only Windows x64 dependency

Source: https://github.com/HDFGroup/hdf5, tag hdf5_1.14.4
Commit: 88429b015e29c59de604b0f552001fb7cb7ed5d0
Licenses: COPYING and COPYING_LBNL_HDF5 in this directory.

The supplied hdf5.dll and import library were built from this upstream source
with MSVC x64 Release, BUILD_SHARED_LIBS=ON, HDF5_ENABLE_Z_LIB_SUPPORT=ON,
HDF5_ENABLE_SZIP_SUPPORT=OFF, and tools/examples/tests/HL/CPP/Fortran disabled.
No SZIP implementation is included. This replaces the initially evaluated
reference-project binary whose optional compression provenance was not assumed.

The DLL statically links zlib 1.3.1:
Source: https://github.com/madler/zlib, tag v1.3.1
Commit: 51b7f2abdade71cd9bb0e7a373ef2610ec6f9daf
License: LICENSE-zlib in this directory.

BUILD-INFO.json records the binary SHA256 and verified gzip/SZIP availability.
HUMA's four imported datasets use gzip; they do not require SZIP.
HDF5 itself retains other standard built-in filters.
The importer reads files read-only and does not create H5 datasets.

Public headers are from HDF5 1.14.4; H5pubconf.h matches this no-SZIP build.
No HighFive wrapper, numpy, h5py, model H5 or model-derived arrays are bundled
in this third-party library directory. The authorized model is selected by
the user at import time. HDF5 is used only by the UncookedOnly Editor module.
